# Implementation Plan: Factory/Card Planner MVP Core Loop

**Branch**: 001-project-principles-factory | **Date**: 2025-10-14 | **Spec**: specs/001-project-principles-factory/spec.md  
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/001-project-principles-factory/spec.md`

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit.plan`. Refer to `.specify/memory/constitution.md` before editing.

## Summary

Deliver a deterministic, client-only factory planner that lets operations planners assemble resource graphs, navigate facility hierarchy, and diagnose clamps without backend services. Implementation centers on a React + React Flow canvas driven by a deterministic simulation engine running in web workers, with IndexedDB-backed saves and golden fixture tests to enforce reproducibility and performance budgets.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Node.js 22 LTS  
**Package Manager**: pnpm 8  
**UI Stack**: React 18, React Flow 11, Tailwind CSS 3, Vite 5  
**Documentation Standard**: JSDoc for runtime APIs plus Markdown guides (quickstart, ADRs)  
**Storage**: In-memory application state with Dexie-powered IndexedDB snapshots and JSON import/export saves  
**Testing Strategy**: Vitest (unit/integration), React Testing Library (component behavior), Playwright (deterministic end-to-end graph flows)  
**Target Platform**: Desktop web (Chromium, Firefox) running fully offline  
**Performance Goals**: =16ms per simulation tick for the 150-node reference graph; gauges degrade and log when budget exceeded  
**Determinism Guarantees**: Single xorshift128+ RNG seeded from save metadata, deterministic tick ordering, golden fixture hashes for graph outputs  
**Constraints**: Offline-only, no telemetry, WCAG-compliant UI colors with redundancy, strict typed pins, sandboxed plugin execution  
**Scale/Scope**: Support company?structure?room?zone hierarchy with up to 150 nodes / 300 edges per zone and first-party plugin bundle covering 20 node types

## Constitution Check

- **P1 Vision & Scope** — PASS: React Flow graph-first client app with no backend dependencies.  
- **P2 Determinism & Reproducibility** — PASS: Seeded xorshift RNG, deterministic workers, golden fixtures.  
- **P3 Safety & Simulation Constraints** — PASS: Typed pins, explicit energy inputs, clamp surfacing baked into simulation badges.  
- **P4 Economy-Neutral Design** — PASS: Funds/cost abstractions only; currency-free UI copy.  
- **P5 Modding & Extensibility** — PASS: Plugin manifests validated client-side, sandboxed deterministic workers.  
- **P6 Performance & Budgets** — PASS: Published 16ms tick budget with degradation rules.  
- **P7 UX & Interaction** — PASS: Always-visible scaffolding, undo/redo, accessibility redundancies.  
- **P8 Workforce & Maintenance** — PASS: Deterministic labor pool scheduler with maintenance debt clamps.  
- **P9 Validation & Testing** — PASS: Schema validation, Vitest + Playwright coverage, golden fixtures.  
- **P10 Data & Persistence** — PASS: Portable JSON saves, IndexedDB snapshots, offline execution.  
- **P11 Failure Modes & Observability** — PASS: Fail-fast validation, clamp tooltips, optional debug pane logging.  
- **P12 Governance & Documentation** — PASS: ADRs for irreversible choices, spec-first workflow, changelog updates.  
- **P13 Internationalization** — PASS: English governance docs with localization-ready UI strings.  
- **P14 Non-Goals** — PASS: No multiplayer, agronomy sim, or currency symbols planned.

**Structure Decision**: Host the playable client in `apps/factory`, share deterministic simulation and UI libraries via `packages/sim-core`, `packages/sim-fixtures`, and `packages/ui-kit`, and centralize automation in `scripts/`. Tests are split by level to mirror constitution mandates for deterministic coverage.
